prompt:
A live-action photograph: the first frame of Shot 1 of a scene of a short drama, vertical composition, as a cinema camera records it on set. Shot size: extreme wide shot; angle: low angle; camera: Extreme wide shot, locked-off camera, low angle, establishing insert outside the jail. It shows: The blocky grey concrete jail building behind a tall chain-link fence topped with coils of razor wire, under a clear sky.
Frame it exactly as the shot says, at that shot size and angle: a close-up fills the frame with the face, a wide shot shows the whole place.

Nobody is in frame: no person, figure or silhouette. Nobody else is in frame. Each person appears once, at natural scale, with the face, hair, body and outfit of their character sheet.

Real adult faces with natural skin texture and pores, real fabric, natural light falloff and shadows, a slight film grain and the depth of field of a real lens, as in a frame of a live-action film. Not a 3D render, an interior-design visualisation, an illustration or a painting; no text, letters, numbers, labels or watermark.
